parsed.post: New best! Combined DEPTH 6, 11 shards, and halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144, achieving val_bpb 0.8529. Halving the batch size allowed for more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll test WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if we can further stabilize and improve convergence.
parsed.description: Halving batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, then adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 for stability.
